records.claim: Due to the lack of studies, it has been suggested that evolocumab be used with caution while breastfeeding, especially with a newborn or an infant born preterm. However, the benefit of using evolocumab, along with the benefits of breastfeeding your child, may outweigh possible risks. Your healthcare providers can talk with you about using evolocumab and what treatment is best for you. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
